ci95_metadata.note: these original decision-metric intervals are descriptive pointwise intervals; use familywise_regret_contrasts_vs_naive for multiplicity-adjusted inference on the primary regret contrast family

definitions.centered_error: subtract random-category-exposure-share-weighted category mean from both the estimate and randomized reference; report unweighted MAE across categories
definitions.ranking_margin_proposition: if max absolute centered category error is strictly below half the reference rank-k/rank-(k+1) boundary gap, the top-k set is unchanged; this is sufficient, not necessary
definitions.reference_regret: mean random-reference outcome over the reference top-k minus mean random-reference outcome over the candidate top-k; lower is better and zero is optimal
definitions.shift_only: naive category means plus random grand mean minus standard grand mean; ranking-identical to naive by construction
definitions.tie_note: a reference boundary tie may reduce set overlap while leaving reference regret at zero
definitions.tie_rule: sort by descending score, then ascending category string label for exact ties
definitions.topk_overlap: intersection size divided by k; higher is better

familywise_regret_contrasts_vs_naive.contrast_definition: estimator reference regret minus naive reference regret; negative favors the estimator
familywise_regret_contrasts_vs_naive.family_definition: all CE-minus-naive and RW-minus-naive reference-regret contrasts across the requested top-k cutoffs
familywise_regret_contrasts_vs_naive.method: single-step paired-user bootstrap standardized max-|t| interval; each contrast uses its across-draw bootstrap SD and the common critical value is the confidence quantile of the draw-wise maximum absolute standardized deviation from the point estimate
